name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

keyboard.description: Moves focus to and from the toggle.

accessibilityNotes: Toggle renders as a native `<button type="button">` with `aria-pressed` reflecting its toggled state, so assistive tech announces the control and its state without extra ARIA wiring — always pass `aria-label` (or wrap it with a visible label) since Toggle has no built-in accessible name of its own.
Disabling a toggle removes it from the tab order and blocks pointer input.

Icon-only toggles (an icon with no visible text, e.g. the RTL example's icon+label pared down to just the icon) need an explicit `aria-label` — the icon alone gives assistive tech nothing to announce.

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A plain toggle button, off until clicked.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Toggle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle/toggle.marko";
{ pressed = next; } aria-label="Toggle italic" > Controlled pressed: ${pressed}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `pressed` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `pressedChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `pressed:=state`.

examples.title: Outline
examples.source:
import Toggle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle/toggle.marko";

<Toggle variant="outline" aria-label="Toggle italic">Italic</Toggle>

examples.title: With Text
examples.description: A toggle can combine an icon and a text label as its content.

examples.title: Size
examples.source:
import Toggle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle/toggle.marko";
Small Default Large
examples.description: Pass `size` as `sm`, `default`, or `lg` to change the toggle's size.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import Toggle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle/toggle.marko";
Disabled Disabled pressed
examples.description: A disabled toggle is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Toggle from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/toggle/toggle.marko"; import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";
إشارة مرجعية
examples.description: Toggle restyles correctly under `dir="rtl"`. Unlike our Zag-machine components, Toggle is a plain native `<button>` with local state, so `dir="rtl"` on the element (or an ancestor) is a complete port with no machine-level RTL gap.
